svg.desc: ScadaCraft OpenBridge widget: Start/stop switch (obc-start-stop-switch, OpenBridge 1.0.0, Apache-2.0). Library: OpenBridge · Controls. Box 240x48 px, anchor at (0,0). Bindable properties: _pb_running (default false, rw): Running state; slide to start/stop writes it (1/0) _ps_size (default 'regular', read): Size: regular | large _pb_alarm (default false, read): Alarm state _pb_disabled (default false, read): Disabled (operator cannot act)
